releaseNotes: v3.9.0: FIXED: All images/posters now load correctly — root cause was OkHttp 5.0.0-alpha.14 binary-incompatible with Coil 2.7.0 (NoSuchMethodError on every fetch); downgraded to OkHttp 4.12.0 and pinned via resolutionStrategy. NEW: Movie Detail Screen — tap any movie poster to open a full detail view with backdrop, poster, rating, plot, director, cast, genre, runtime, MPAA rating, and similar titles rail. Play from detail screen or go back to the grid.
